ui_qr.title: Customer QR codes
ui_qr.intro: Every QR holds a short permanent link. You choose where it leads here and can change it any time — no reprinting. It can open the built-in QR ordering page, the published website, or any address you give (for example a page you built in Elementor).
ui_qr.base_url: Main domain printed in the QR
ui_qr.base_hint: The domain customers see (e.g. https://app.example.com). It is printed inside the QR.
ui_qr.label: Label (e.g. Table 5)
ui_qr.bulk_title: Create table QRs in one go
ui_qr.saved: Saved; printed QR codes now lead to the new target.
ui_qr.confirm_delete: Delete “{{label}}”? Its printed QR will stop working.
